description: Land Aquisition - Revocation Under Section.39 (1) Dikkumbura, Kandeketiya D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their boundaries, extents, and locations in Dikkumbura Village. While it mentions a government minister (K. D. Lal Kantha) and his title, the core content focuses on the revocation of a land acquisition order and the technical details of the land parcels involved, making it primarily a land-related matter rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
